title: Terrain piece type (the engine reads rulesType and props, never the mesh)

rulesType.description: Mirrors TerrainRulesType in the engine. An obstacle is under 1 inch tall; an obstruction or building is 1 inch or taller (checked by the data loader).

props.description: Defaults come from rulesType (20-data-schema section 9). Every key here is read by the engine (terrainTraits and the LOS code); set only to override.

blocksLos.description: Override whether the prism blocks LOS by height.

losThrough.description: Forest: a line that starts or ends inside may cross this much (default 3).

cover.description: false removes cover; true grants it (along a line for walls, buildings and obstructions, completely inside for the rest).

concealment.description: Grants concealment instead of cover (hedge, fence) unless cover is also true.

elevation.description: Hill: the surface height for models completely within.

resistance.description: A model completely inside resists these damage types.

hazard.description: R9.8: effect holds one damage node (pow, damageType). on defaults to both triggers.

feature.description: Obstacle drawn and played as a hedge (concealment).

baseType.description: scenarioTerrain: the rules type it plays as (default obstacle).

baseElev.description: Height the prism's base sits above the table.

mesh.description: GLB slug; procedural prism if absent.
